topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Increasing array size enhances gain but introduces higher insertion loss, reducing radiation efficiency. This trade-off affects network performance, leading to increased signal attenuation and bit error rates. Optimizing hybrid feeding topology and material selection can mitigate these effects, balancing gain enhancement against efficiency loss.
reference_context: SIW arrays face trade-offs between size, gain, and efficiency, with larger arrays suffering from higher insertion loss and reduced radiation efficiency.
